changelog: CelerOS: canal de updates do devkit-s3 (ESP32-S3 N16R8, USB Host, sem display). Este manifest e espelho legado; o dispositivo consulta o hub (os.celer.tec.br/updates). Publicacao via tools/publish_firmware.py no repo CelerOS-Server.
guide: Updates install directly on the device: open Settings > System Updates and tap INSTALL. Alternatively open the web file manager and use Firmware Update.
